newsitem.title: UK: Merrill to build office in London - paper.
newsitem.headline: Merrill to build office in London - paper.

text.p: Merrill Lynch and Co Inc, the U.S. investment bank, will announce on Tuesday that it will build a 300 million pound head office in London, The Independent newspaper reported in its Tuesday edition.
"The 500,000 square foot building will enable Merrill to house 1,000 more people in London, and represents a big vote of confidence in the City as a world financial centre," the paper said.
The office will be located on the site of the old Royal Mail sorting office in King Edward Street, London, the newspaper said.
The newspaper said Merrill declined to comment.
A consultant close to the deal said the bank had considered moving to Canary Wharf in London but turned down the idea over worries the location was too far from the city.
The paper said it is understood that Merrill will transfer its staff from Ropemaker Place in the City to the new building when it is completed in 2001.
The bank intends to retains its building in Farringdon Road, which houses the former Smith New Court market making operation and its private client business in Chester Street.
